code.default:
try:
    vars['say'] = "Hello, this is Freya Bank's digital assistant calling from Freya Bank. We are recording this call. Am I speaking with {title} {last_name}?".replace('{title}', str(vars.get('title') or '')).replace('{last_name}', str(vars.get('last_name') or ''))
except Exception:
    vars['say'] = 'Hello.'
vars['st'] = 'confirm'
vars['asks'] = 1
vars['act'] = 'talk'
vars['intent'] = 'none'
vars['side_q'] = 'none'
vars['outcome'] = ''
vars['reason'] = ''
vars['bye'] = 'Thank you for your time. Goodbye.'

talk.name: talk
talk.task_message:
You are Freya Bank's digital assistant on a phone call. Speak English.
Say exactly this text: "{{say}}"
Say exactly this text. Never promise a transfer, a callback or any other action that the text does not state. Do not add facts, amounts or dates.

extraction_schema.name: intent
extraction_schema.description: The main thing the customer said in their LAST message. none: nothing new was said | yes: the customer says yes, confirms, agrees, 'that's me', 'speaking', or says their own name | no: a plain no (for example to paying today, to an offer, or to the read-back), with no date and no amount | not_me: the speaker says they are not the customer (a relative, partner, someone else), even if they also ask a question | wrong_number: the number does not belong to the customer / nobody of that name here | deceased: the customer has died | purpose: asks what the call is about / why we are calling | human: asks to speak to a person, a human, an agent | not_talk: says they do not want to talk / not interested / will not answer questions / hang up | paid: says they already paid this past-due amount (a past payment) | dispute: says the debt or product is not theirs, never had it, or the product was closed or paid off in the past | hardship: mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss | plan: explicitly asks for a new payment plan, instalments, lower instalments or a longer term; naming a date they can pay on is NOT a plan | too_much: says the amount is too much / cannot afford the full amount, without naming an amount | change_recorded: asks to change or cancel a promise already recorded | discount: asks for a discount, a waiver, a reduction of the debt or other special terms (an explicit request for a payment plan or instalments is plan, not discount) | unclear: the answer is cut off, unclear or only small talk (hello, go ahead) | other: anything else. If they give a date or an amount they can pay, use yes/no/other only as fits and fill date_words/amount_words.

extraction_schema.name: side_q
extraction_schema.description: A side question in the last message: robot = asks if this is a robot or AI; scam = asks if this is a scam or real; other_question = another question about the account; none = no question.

extraction_schema.name: date_words
extraction_schema.description: The customer's own words for a day or date in the last message, copied as said (e.g. 'next Friday', 'the 20th', 'tomorrow', 'end of the month'). 'none' if no day was said.

extraction_schema.name: time_words
extraction_schema.description: The customer's own words for a clock time in the last message, as said (e.g. 'three pm', '11:30', 'eleven in the morning'), with the day if said. 'none' if none.

extraction_schema.name: amount_words
extraction_schema.description: An amount of money the customer says they can pay, as said (e.g. '200', 'one hundred fifty'). 'none' if none. Not a date, not phone digits.

extraction_schema.name: answer_words
extraction_schema.description: The customer's answer to a security question, copied as said: a date of birth (or part of it) or phone digits. 'none' if none.
